mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to identify words or phrases that are to be subject to some legislative action."
Inverted commas are used to identify words or phrases that are to be subject to some legislative action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used not just to list or tabulate a series of items or alternatives."
Paragraphs are used not just to list or tabulate a series of items or alternatives.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a valuable tool for drafters since they preclude the need to provide unnecessary detail and allow legislation to be adapted to circumstances as they arise."
Indeterminate terms are a valuable tool for drafters since they preclude the need to provide unnecessary detail and allow legislation to be adapted to circumstances as they arise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that deal with a common subject matter or contain concepts that inter-connect."
Related provisions are those that deal with a common subject matter or contain concepts that inter-connect.
fib: ______ refers to "carrying" and "having" in reference to the search power, but introduces "possession" in relation to forfeiture.
The original refers to "carrying" and "having" in reference to the search power, but introduces "possession" in relation to forfeiture.
______ is a legal person; it is that person's behaviour with which the rule is principally concerned.
The subject is a legal person; it is that person's behaviour with which the rule is principally concerned.
______ refer to those who have to govern their conduct by the rules, rather than the beneficiary of them.
The grammatical subject should refer to those who have to govern their conduct by the rules, rather than the beneficiary of them.
______ is concerned in the main with the extent and the exercise of the authority to detain individuals.
Example Box 6 A Bill regulating the prison system is concerned in the main with the extent and the exercise of the authority to detain individuals.
